---
title: "Browse datasets"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<div id="browse" class="browse">
  <div id="browse-intro"><p>Loading the catalog…</p></div>
  <noscript><div class="alert alert-warning">The dataset browser needs JavaScript.</div></noscript>
  <div id="browse-warning"></div>

  <div class="browse-top">
    <label class="visually-hidden" for="browse-search">Search datasets</label>
    <input id="browse-search" type="search" class="form-control browse-search"
      placeholder='Search variables, models, experiments… e.g. "sea surface temperature"' autocomplete="off">
    <div id="browse-collections" class="browse-collections" role="group" aria-label="Collection"></div>
    <div id="browse-chips" class="browse-chips" aria-live="polite"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="browse-main">
    <button id="browse-filters-toggle" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary d-lg-none mb-2"
      data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#browse-facets" aria-controls="browse-facets"
      aria-expanded="false">Filters</button>
    <div id="browse-facets" class="browse-facets collapse d-lg-block" role="region" aria-label="Filters"></div>
    <section class="browse-results" aria-label="Results">
      <div class="browse-results-head">
        <span id="browse-count" aria-live="polite"></span>
        <span class="ms-auto d-flex gap-2">
          <span class="dropdown">
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary dropdown-toggle" type="button"
              data-bs-toggle="dropdown" data-bs-auto-close="outside" aria-expanded="false">Columns</button>
            <ul id="browse-columns-menu" class="dropdown-menu dropdown-menu-end"></ul>
          </span>
          <button id="browse-csv" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">Download table (CSV)</button>
        </span>
      </div>
      <div id="browse-table" class="browse-table"></div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <div id="browse-bar" class="browse-bar" aria-live="polite"></div>
</div>
```
